fields.description: Unique identifier for the application before policy conversion
fields.validation: Required, format: "APP-XXXX" where X is a digit
fields.mappingNotes: Map to ApplicationNumber in external systems. Remove "APP-" prefix if needed.

fields.description: Unique identifier for the policy after conversion from application
fields.validation: Format: "PSPI-YYYY-XXXXXX" where YYYY is year and X is sequential
fields.mappingNotes: Primary key for policy records. Map to PolicyID in legacy systems.

fields.description: Type of insurance product selected
fields.sampleValue: Power Select Plus Income® Index Annuity
fields.mappingNotes: Map to ProductName. Ensure product codes are synchronized.

fields.description: Internal product identifier from product catalog
fields.mappingNotes: Map to ProductCode. Use for product lookup and feature availability.

fields.description: Current status of the application/policy in the workflow
fields.validation: One of: "Submitted", "Underwriter Review", "Additional Requirements", "Approved", "Converted to Policy"
fields.mappingNotes: Map to StatusCode. Status transitions must follow workflow rules.

fields.description: Date when the application was initially submitted
fields.mappingNotes: Convert to target system date format. Use for aging calculations.

fields.description: Date when the policy was officially issued
fields.validation: ISO 8601 date format, must be >= submittedDate
fields.mappingNotes: Policy effective date. Important for anniversary calculations.

fields.description: Current status of an issued policy
fields.mappingNotes: Different from application status. Only applies to converted policies.

fields.description: Full legal name of the policy owner
fields.mappingNotes: Primary policyholder. Map to OwnerFullName or split into FirstName/LastName.

fields.description: Date of birth of the policy owner
fields.validation: ISO 8601 format, must be at least 18 years old
fields.mappingNotes: Use for age calculations and eligibility. Convert to MM/DD/YYYY for some systems.

fields.description: Primary email address for the policy owner
fields.mappingNotes: Used for authentication and communications. Must be unique per customer.

fields.description: Primary phone number for the policy owner
fields.mappingNotes: Remove formatting for numeric-only systems: 5551234567

fields.description: Social Security Number of the policy owner
fields.validation: Format: XXX-XX-XXXX, must be valid SSN
fields.mappingNotes: Highly sensitive PII. Encrypt in transit and at rest. Show only last 4 digits in UI.

fields.description: Street address line of the owner's permanent residence
fields.mappingNotes: Map to AddressLine1. May need to split apartment/suite to AddressLine2.

fields.description: City of the owner's permanent residence
fields.mappingNotes: Validate against state/zip for accuracy.

fields.description: State code of the owner's permanent residence
fields.mappingNotes: Use for licensing and regulatory compliance. Convert to full state name if needed.

fields.description: ZIP code of the owner's permanent residence
fields.mappingNotes: Use 5-digit format for most systems. ZIP+4 for precision if available.

fields.description: Indicates if the owner has a secondary/seasonal residence
fields.mappingNotes: If true, seasonal address fields will be populated.

fields.description: Array of all individuals associated with the policy (owner, joint owner, annuitant)
fields.validation: Array of ClientInfo objects, minimum 1 entry
fields.mappingNotes: Iterate through array to extract all parties. Relationship field determines role.

fields.description: Array of client objects including owner, joint owner, annuitant, and joint annuitant
fields.validation: Array of ClientInfo objects with name, dob, ssn, relationship
fields.mappingNotes: Replaces single owner fields. Supports joint ownership and separate annuitants.

fields.description: Full legal name of client (owner, annuitant, etc.)
fields.validation: String, 2-100 characters, must match legal ID
fields.mappingNotes: Must match name on driver license or government ID. Required for each client in array.

fields.description: Date of birth for client
fields.validation: ISO 8601 date format: YYYY-MM-DD, must be 18+ years old
fields.mappingNotes: Used for age-based calculations (annuity rates, RMDs, etc.). Must verify with ID.

fields.description: Social Security Number for client
fields.validation: Format: XXX-XX-XXXX, must be valid SSN
fields.mappingNotes: Required for tax reporting (1099-R, etc.). Highly sensitive PII. Store encrypted.

fields.description: Role of client in policy (owner, joint-owner, annuitant, joint-annuitant)
fields.mappingNotes: Determines control rights and payment obligations. Owner controls policy; annuitant affects payout calculations.

fields.description: Primary residential address object with street, city, state, zip
fields.validation: Object with required fields: street, city, state (2-letter code), zip (5 or 9 digits)
fields.mappingNotes: Used for mailing, state tax withholding determination, and regulatory compliance.

fields.description: Street address line including number and street name
fields.mappingNotes: Do not include city/state/zip in this field.

fields.description: City name for permanent address
fields.mappingNotes: Standard city name, no abbreviations.

fields.description: State code for permanent address
fields.mappingNotes: Determines state-specific regulations and tax withholding. Use USPS state codes.

fields.description: ZIP code for permanent address
fields.mappingNotes: Use 5-digit or ZIP+4 format. Validate against USPS database if possible.

fields.description: Indicates if owner has a seasonal/secondary address
fields.mappingNotes: If true, seasonalAddress object must be populated. Used for snowbirds, etc.

fields.description: Secondary address object for seasonal residents
fields.validation: Object with same structure as permanentAddress
fields.mappingNotes: Used for correspondence during winter months, etc. Not used for tax purposes.

fields.description: Initial premium payment amount for the annuity
fields.mappingNotes: Store as numeric value without currency symbols. Format with $ and commas for display.

fields.description: ID of the selected Guaranteed Lifetime Benefit rider
fields.validation: Must match a GLB rider ID from product catalog
fields.mappingNotes: Reference to GLB rider configuration. Lookup full details from rider catalog.

fields.description: Coverage type for GLB rider
fields.mappingNotes: Determines payout structure. Joint life requires spouse information.

fields.description: Array of index account allocations with strategies and percentages
fields.validation: Array of objects with accountId, indexId, term, allocationPercentage
fields.mappingNotes: Each entry represents an index strategy allocation. Sum of allocations + fixed must equal 100%.

fields.description: Unique identifier for an index account within the allocation array
fields.mappingNotes: Internal tracking ID for each index account selection.

fields.description: Code for the selected index strategy (e.g., S&P 500 Point-to-Point)
fields.validation: Must exist in available indices catalog
fields.mappingNotes: Reference to index strategy configuration with cap rates and participation.

fields.description: Term length in years for the index crediting strategy
fields.mappingNotes: Determines crediting period. Affects cap rates and renewal terms.

fields.description: Percentage of premium allocated to this index account
fields.validation: Numeric 0-100, sum of all allocations must equal 100%
fields.mappingNotes: Store as numeric. Total allocation validation includes fixed account.

fields.description: Percentage of premium allocated to the fixed interest account
fields.validation: Numeric 0-100, combined with index allocations must equal 100%
fields.mappingNotes: Guaranteed fixed rate allocation. May have minimum/maximum restrictions.

fields.description: Indicates if Extended Care Rider is selected
fields.mappingNotes: Additional benefit for long-term care needs. May have age restrictions.

fields.description: Indicates if Terminal Illness Rider is selected
fields.mappingNotes: Allows accelerated benefit access for terminal diagnosis.

fields.description: Indicates if Enhanced Income Rider is selected
fields.mappingNotes: Provides enhanced income benefits. May affect fees.

fields.description: Indicates if Extended Care (long-term care) rider is elected
fields.mappingNotes: Provides enhanced withdrawals for qualifying long-term care expenses. May require medical underwriting.

fields.description: Indicates if Terminal Illness rider is elected
fields.mappingNotes: Allows accelerated death benefit if owner is diagnosed with terminal illness (12-24 month life expectancy).

fields.description: Indicates if Enhanced Income rider is elected
fields.mappingNotes: Provides higher guaranteed lifetime withdrawal percentages. Usually has additional cost.

fields.description: Specific income rider product selected (if applicable)
fields.validation: String matching available income rider products
fields.mappingNotes: Maps to product catalog. Affects guaranteed withdrawal rates and fees.

fields.description: Benefit base or guaranteed value for income rider
fields.validation: Numeric, positive value, may be calculated based on premium and bonuses
fields.mappingNotes: Initial benefit base for lifetime income calculations. May grow annually.

fields.description: Type of death benefit rider elected
fields.mappingNotes: Determines death benefit calculation (account value, highest anniversary value, return of premium, etc.).

fields.description: Guaranteed death benefit amount (if applicable)
fields.mappingNotes: Minimum death benefit payable to beneficiaries. May be higher of guaranteed amount or account value.

fields.description: Total annual household gross income range
fields.validation: One of predefined ranges: "Less than $25,000", "$25,000-$50,000", etc.
fields.mappingNotes: Suitability requirement. Convert ranges to numeric for calculations if needed.

fields.description: Annual household living expenses range
fields.validation: One of predefined ranges matching income format
fields.mappingNotes: Used for suitability analysis. Compare with income for cash flow adequacy.

fields.description: Total household net worth range
fields.mappingNotes: Critical for suitability. Premium should be reasonable percentage of net worth.

fields.description: Array of income source types
fields.validation: Array of strings from predefined list (Salary, Social Security, Pension, etc.)
fields.mappingNotes: Multiple selections allowed. If includes "Other", see householdIncomeSourcesOther field.

fields.description: Owner's federal income tax bracket
fields.mappingNotes: Important for tax-deferred annuity suitability. Higher bracket = more tax advantage.

fields.description: Whether owner has adequate liquid reserves for emergencies
fields.mappingNotes: Suitability requirement. "No" may require additional review or decline.

fields.description: Expected premium amount from suitability section
fields.mappingNotes: Cross-reference with premiumAmount for consistency validation.

fields.description: Value of qualified cash accounts (IRA, 401k cash)
fields.mappingNotes: Part of comprehensive asset inventory. Sum all qualified assets for total.

fields.description: Value of non-qualified cash accounts
fields.mappingNotes: Taxable cash reserves. Important for liquidity assessment.

fields.description: Array of account types being used to fund the annuity
fields.validation: Array of strings from predefined list
fields.mappingNotes: Regulatory requirement. Track origin of funds for anti-money laundering.

fields.description: Owner's experience level with annuities and investment products
fields.mappingNotes: Suitability factor. Lower experience requires more disclosure.

fields.description: Owner's tolerance for investment risk
fields.mappingNotes: Critical for product suitability. Affects index account recommendations.

fields.description: Array of owner's financial goals for this annuity
fields.validation: Array of strings: "Retirement Income", "Asset Protection", "Growth", etc.
fields.mappingNotes: Multiple selections allowed. Validates product appropriateness.

fields.description: When owner anticipates needing to access funds
fields.validation: One of: "Less than 1 year", "1-5 years", "5-10 years", "Longer than 10 years", "None Anticipated"
fields.mappingNotes: Must align with surrender period. Early withdrawal needs may indicate unsuitability.

fields.description: How owner plans to take withdrawals
fields.mappingNotes: Multiple methods possible. Affects rider recommendations.

fields.description: Expected holding period for the annuity
fields.validation: One of: "less than 3 years", "3-7 years", "7-10 years", "longer than 10 years"
fields.mappingNotes: Must be consistent with surrender period and withdrawal timeline.

fields.description: Whether owner expects withdrawals before age 59½
fields.validation: One of: "Yes", "No", "N/A (Owner has attained age 59½ or older)"
fields.mappingNotes: Tax penalty warning. "Yes" requires explanation field.

fields.description: Whether owner may need to exceed penalty-free withdrawal limits
fields.mappingNotes: Surrender charge warning. "Yes" requires explanation and may indicate unsuitability.

fields.description: Whether this purchase replaces an existing annuity or life insurance
fields.mappingNotes: Triggers replacement documentation requirements. Must compare products.

fields.description: Indicates if this application replaces an existing contract
fields.mappingNotes: Regulatory requirement. If "Yes", must complete replacement form and provide existing contract details.

fields.description: Name of insurance company for existing contract being replaced
fields.validation: String, company name from dropdown or free text
fields.mappingNotes: Required if replacingExisting is "Yes". May trigger state-specific replacement forms.

fields.description: Product name of existing contract being replaced
fields.mappingNotes: Helps identify if replacement is suitable (e.g., similar products, surrender charges).

fields.description: Policy/contract number of existing contract
fields.mappingNotes: Used for verification and exchange forms (1035 exchanges).

fields.description: Current cash value of existing contract
fields.mappingNotes: May be used for 1035 tax-free exchange calculations.

fields.description: Portion of existing contract value that is qualified (IRA, 401k, etc.)
fields.validation: Numeric, positive value, must be <= existingValue
fields.mappingNotes: Determines if replacement involves qualified or non-qualified funds. Affects tax treatment.

fields.description: Years remaining in surrender charge period for existing contract
fields.mappingNotes: Key suitability factor. Agent must justify replacement if surrender charges apply.

fields.description: Percentage of surrender charge if contract is surrendered now
fields.mappingNotes: Used to calculate cost of replacement. If high, may not be suitable.

fields.description: Bonus interest rate on existing contract that may be forfeited
fields.mappingNotes: Some contracts have bonus interest that is lost upon early surrender. Factor in suitability.

fields.description: Dollar amount of bonus that would be forfeited on existing contract
fields.mappingNotes: Calculated as bonusInterest * existingValue. Helps assess replacement cost.

fields.description: Indicator if health questions were asked during application
fields.mappingNotes: Most annuities do not require health underwriting. If "Yes", additional medical records may be needed.

fields.description: Internal notes added by underwriting department during review
fields.sampleValue: Application approved with standard terms. No exceptions required.
fields.mappingNotes: For internal use only. Not visible to agents or clients.

fields.description: List of additional documents or information needed from applicant
fields.sampleValue: Need clarification on source of funds for account XYZ
fields.mappingNotes: Used when application status is "Additional Requirements". Agent notified via email.

fields.description: Date application was approved by underwriter
fields.mappingNotes: Automatically set when status changes to "Approved". Used for aging reports.

fields.description: Reason for application rejection if not approved
fields.mappingNotes: Only populated if application is rejected. Agent receives notification.

fields.description: List of agent acknowledgement statements confirmed
fields.validation: Array of strings matching predefined acknowledgements
fields.sampleValue: ["I have completed suitability analysis", "I have verified client identity"]
fields.mappingNotes: Regulatory compliance tracking. Each acknowledgement must be checked before submission.

fields.description: Agent acknowledgement that replacement process was followed if applicable
fields.mappingNotes: Required if replacingExisting is "Yes". Agent confirms replacement forms completed.

fields.description: Agent confirmation of Anti-Money Laundering verification completed
fields.mappingNotes: Required for large premiums ($10,000+). Agent verifies source of funds is legitimate.

fields.description: Additional comments or notes from agent about application
fields.sampleValue: Client is using proceeds from CD maturity. Conservative investor.
fields.mappingNotes: Optional field for agent to provide context to underwriters.

fields.description: Digital signature or acknowledgement from agent
fields.validation: String representing signature data or "SIGNED" indicator
fields.mappingNotes: E-signature or checkbox confirmation. Timestamp recorded separately.

fields.description: Date agent signed/submitted application
fields.mappingNotes: Auto-populated at submission. Used for compliance and audit trails.

fields.description: List of owner acknowledgement statements confirmed
fields.validation: Array of strings matching predefined acknowledgements
fields.sampleValue: ["I understand surrender charges apply", "I acknowledge state guarantee limits"]
fields.mappingNotes: Client must confirm understanding of product features and limitations.

fields.description: Owner acknowledgement of state guarantee fund coverage limits
fields.mappingNotes: Required disclosure. Owner must understand coverage limits (typically $250,000).

fields.description: Owner confirmation they understand annuity features and risks
fields.mappingNotes: Suitability requirement. Owner confirms they received and understand product disclosures.

fields.description: Optional comments from policy owner
fields.mappingNotes: Rarely used. May contain special instructions or clarifications.

fields.description: Digital signature or acknowledgement from policy owner
fields.validation: String representing signature data or "SIGNED" indicator
fields.mappingNotes: Required for application submission. E-signature with IP tracking.

fields.description: Date owner signed application
fields.mappingNotes: Must be same day or before agent signature date. Free-look period starts from this date.

fields.description: Unique identifier for the transaction
fields.mappingNotes: Primary key for transaction records. Use for reconciliation.

fields.description: Policy number associated with this transaction
fields.mappingNotes: Foreign key to policy record. Use for transaction history queries.

fields.description: Date when the transaction occurred
fields.mappingNotes: Posted date. Use for statement periods and reporting.

fields.description: Type of transaction
fields.mappingNotes: Affects accounting treatment. Map to general ledger codes.

fields.description: Human-readable description of the transaction
fields.mappingNotes: Display in transaction history and statements.

fields.description: Dollar amount of the transaction (positive or negative)
fields.validation: Numeric, can be negative for debits
fields.mappingNotes: Positive = credit, Negative = debit. Store as cents for precision.

fields.description: Account balance after this transaction
fields.mappingNotes: Running balance. Calculate cumulatively for account value.

fields.description: Processing status of the transaction
fields.mappingNotes: Only "Completed" transactions affect balance. Track "Pending" separately.

fields.description: Unique identifier for the commission record
fields.mappingNotes: Primary key for commission tracking.

fields.description: Policy number that generated this commission
fields.mappingNotes: Link to policy for commission calculations.

fields.description: Name of the client for this commission
fields.mappingNotes: For agent reporting and commission statements.

fields.description: Commission percentage for first year
fields.mappingNotes: Store as decimal. Multiply by premium for commission amount.

fields.description: Dollar amount of first year commission
fields.mappingNotes: Calculated field. May be paid immediately or at policy anniversary.

fields.description: Whether first year commission has been paid
fields.mappingNotes: Payment tracking. Use with firstYearPaidDate.

fields.description: Annual commission percentage for renewal years
fields.validation: Decimal 0-1, typically lower than first year
fields.mappingNotes: Trail commission. Applied to account value annually.

fields.description: Cumulative total of all commissions earned on this policy
fields.validation: Numeric, sum of first year + all renewals
fields.mappingNotes: Running total. Update annually with renewal payments.

fields.description: Status of commission payments
fields.mappingNotes: "Active" = generating renewals. "Cancelled" = policy lapsed/surrendered.

fields.description: Unique agent identifier/writing code
fields.mappingNotes: Primary agent identifier. Use for commission routing and reporting.

fields.description: Full name of the agent
fields.mappingNotes: Agent of record. Display on policy documents.

fields.description: Agent's business email address
fields.mappingNotes: For commission statements and policy notifications.

fields.description: Agent's business phone number
fields.mappingNotes: Primary contact for application questions.

fields.description: State insurance license number
fields.mappingNotes: Verify license is active and state-appropriate before policy issue.

fields.description: State where agent is licensed
fields.validation: 2-letter state code, must match owner state
fields.mappingNotes: Must be licensed in policy owner's state of residence.

fields.description: National Producer Number
fields.mappingNotes: NAIC identifier. Use for cross-state licensing verification.

fields.description: Full legal name of primary beneficiary
fields.mappingNotes: Receives policy value upon owner's death. Can be individual, trust, or estate.

fields.description: Relationship of primary beneficiary to owner
fields.validation: String from predefined list (Spouse, Child, Sibling, Trust, Estate, etc.)
fields.mappingNotes: May affect spousal continuation options.

fields.description: Social Security Number or Tax ID of primary beneficiary
fields.mappingNotes: Required for tax reporting upon death claim. Highly sensitive PII.

fields.description: Percentage of benefit allocated to primary beneficiary
fields.validation: Numeric 0-100, total of all primary beneficiaries must equal 100
fields.mappingNotes: If multiple primary beneficiaries, percentages must sum to 100%.

fields.description: Full legal name of contingent (secondary) beneficiary
fields.mappingNotes: Receives benefit if all primary beneficiaries predecease owner.
